name: Launch: Find Your Mat-ch is here
to: All subscribers (homepage signup, notify-me form and form subscribers all land there)
subject: It's here! Find Your Mat-ch is live 💕
preview: Pick your tiles, swipe your mats, meet your match.
text:
[IMAGE heading: It’s here!]

This is a new tool I’m rolling out just for you: Find Your Mat-ch™. This time I’m stepping out of the matchmaker seat, and it’s your turn to find your match.

My picks are baked right in, so you’re never swiping alone.

[IMAGE heading: Here’s how it works]

[IMAGE heading: Step 1: Pick your door]
Start with the tiles you own, or start with the mat you already love.
[IMAGE: The Find Your Mat-ch start screen. Arrows point to the two doors: I have tiles, and I have a mat.]

[IMAGE heading: Step 2: Here’s what these buttons do]
Tap ♥ to add a mat to your shortlist and ✕ to skip it. My picks show first; tap the pink button to see every mat. Tap a color dot to shop by color, and tap it again to clear it.
[IMAGE: Swiping mats for Papaya Spritz tiles, with the Heiress mat on screen. Arrows point to the Tiffany’s picks button (turn my picks on or off), the color dots (shop by color), the X button (not for me) and the heart button (love it, add to my shortlist).]

[IMAGE heading: Step 3: Your shortlist]
Every mat you ♥ collects at the bottom, so you can compare. When you’re ready, tap Mock your match.
[IMAGE: The shortlist bar at the bottom of the swipe, holding two loved mats. Arrows point to the shortlist and to the Mock your match button.]

[IMAGE heading: Step 4: Mock up your match]
Swipe racks the same way, with my rack picks first. When you love one, tap Make it official.
[IMAGE: The racks step: Tiffany’s rack match, Middle & Main Scalloped Beechwood, with arrows to the rack and to the X and heart buttons for swiping racks.]

[IMAGE heading: Step 5: Save and share]
Pick your view, then save your match card or send it to your mahj group. Every piece is linked, with code MAHJMATCH.
[IMAGE: The finished match card for Papaya Spritz on Heiress with Beechwood racks. Arrows point to the view buttons and to Save or share my match card.]

[BUTTON: Start swiping → https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match]

Hope you love it!

Something look off or have an idea? Tell me here → (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-mat-ch-feedback)

Use code MAHJMATCH to save 💕

Happy mat-ching!
xo, Tiffany

name: Automation: Welcome (new subscriber)
when: right after someone signs up (on from launch)
subject: Welcome to Mahj Matchmaker! 💕
preview: Three fun places to start, plus a few of my favorite reads.
text:
[IMAGE heading: Hi, I’m Tiffany!]

I’m so glad you’re here! I match mahjong tiles with the mats and racks that make them shine, so your table comes together just the way you dreamed.

[IMAGE heading: Three fun places to start]

• Find Your Mat-ch™: start with your tiles or your mat and swipe, with my picks built right in.

• My tile set albums (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/mahjong-tile-matches): a match card for every mat and rack I’ve paired with each set.

• The discount codes page (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/mahjong-discount-codes): every partner brand that takes our code.

[BUTTON: Start swiping → https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match]

[IMAGE heading: A few of my favorite reads]

• The Mahjong Buying Guide: How to choose tiles, mats and racks (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/blog/mahjong-buying-guide)

• The Most Versatile Mahjong Mats: The mats that go with almost everything (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/blog/most-versatile-mahjong-mats)

• A Holiday Table Without a Christmas Mat: Festive tables with the mat you already own (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/blog/holiday-mahjong-table)

Have an IRL photo of your table you’d love to share with the Mahj Matchmaker community? Submit it here (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/share-your-table), or join our Facebook group (https://www.facebook.com/groups/mahjmatchmaker) and share it there. We often pull photos from the group to feature in the tile albums!

Use code MAHJMATCH to save 💕

Happy mat-ching!
xo, Tiffany

name: Automation: Album request thank-you

to: the person who sent the request
subject: Got it! Your album request is in 💕
preview: The most-asked-for sets get matched first.
text:
[IMAGE heading: Thank you for your request!]

I keep a running tally of every request, and the most-asked-for sets get matched first. When yours goes live, you’ll be the first to know.

While you wait, try Find Your Mat-ch™ to see the mats and racks I’d pair with your set. Don’t see your set in the catalog yet? Shop by color and pick a similar colorway, and you’ll find plenty of matches to swoon over.

[BUTTON: Start swiping → https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match]

Use code MAHJMATCH to save 💕

Happy mat-ching!
xo, Tiffany
